metricDefinitions.statistics: statistics.median and max over valid completed samples; sampleCount is explicit.
metricDefinitions.cacheBoundary: Each invocation uses a new Python process, but measured service calls exclude process launch/module imports. No user or OS file cache is cleared; input SHA/manifest collection can warm archive reads. Cold means the first per-context preparation in that process, not cold physical-disk access.
metricDefinitions.functionTiming: Per-function call count and elapsed sum/max are reported; nested function timings overlap and must not be added across functions.
metricDefinitions.loadOverall: listPackages plus cold first preparation/consumer pass plus same-process repeated preparation/consumer pass; measured endpoint comes from loadTimingSummary.measuredOverallMs.
metricDefinitions.contextsStageSum: The four per-context elapsedMs or preparation/consumer phase values are sums of separate recorded calls, not the full load wall endpoint.
metricDefinitions.stages: service.changed stage markers are retained as timestamps only; stage markers are not added or presented as end-to-end wall time.
metricDefinitions.consumerScope: Service/provider resource reads: typed base/control data and one actual imported author overlay pixel decode per context/pass. Not GUI, game-frame pixels, gameplay, or user acceptance.
metricDefinitions.crossDay: Samples may span multiple days; each sample UTC start/end and ambient snapshot are shown. Other machine work was not isolated.
